name: Geroshabou-chan
source:
Geroshabou-chan is a very tsuntsun tsundere who is physically and verbally abusive to Chichi-chan. But despite her young and weak appearance, she can really beat the shit out of Chichi-chan. She is a cold-hearted bitch on the outside, but she secretly keeps a heart-shaped locket with locks of Chichi-chan’s pubic hair that she rubs all over her face every night. If Chichi-chan can break through her crusty outer shell he will find that she is a very sweet and loving girl, but showing her too much affection may cause her to go yandere and kill Chichi-chan. Geroshabou-chan kawaii!!

[From [url=http://animerand.blogspot.com/2009/05/this-is-development-blog-for-visual.html]Official Site[/url]]
